status_definitions.ARCHIVED_ARCHITECTURE: Retained for engineering history; prohibited as a live route.
status_definitions.TERMINAL_REJECTED: Failed independent or costed evidence; the same hypothesis may not be retuned on revealed OOS.
status_definitions.DATA_BLOCKED: Could not receive a valid test with the available field or horizon.
status_definitions.CALIBRATION_ONLY: Useful for execution measurement, not alpha or promotion.
status_definitions.ENGINEERING_ONLY: Validates plumbing and safety but makes no profitability claim.

hypotheses.claim: Dynamic Pantheon/Flash/agent selection can produce a robust live edge.
hypotheses.verdict: No costed OOS evidence established a robust edge; complexity made signal attribution and parity expensive.
prohibited: using shadow leaderboard as expectancy evidence

hypotheses.claim: GeneticCore agents can be selected and promoted into Bitget live trading.
hypotheses.verdict: No checkpoint passed the mandatory costed validation and OOS contract; all generated checkpoints were removed.

hypotheses.claim: OI, basis, crowding and funding score predicts a costed six-hour move.
hypotheses.verdict: Only 5 policy-allowed trades; mean predicted move 212.17 bps versus realized net -4.33 bps; every exit used max_holding.

hypotheses.claim: A four-hour fixed exit repairs CarryFlow expectancy.
hypotheses.verdict: Independent roots produced -18.12 bps mean versus -1.17 bps baseline; v1 and v5 collapsed.

hypotheses.claim: Leave-one-root-out flow features select positive CarryFlow entries.
hypotheses.verdict: 27 held-out trades, -0.36 bps mean and -30.37 bps LCB.

hypotheses.claim: Hybrid market and flow features improve held-out CarryFlow entries.
hypotheses.verdict: 22 held-out trades, -1.42 bps mean and -39.66 bps LCB; v5 collapsed.

hypotheses.claim: Trading only range-to-trend transitions creates a robust breakout edge.
hypotheses.verdict: 8 trades with positive mean but -15.82 bps LCB, one inactive root and v5 collapse.

hypotheses.claim: Regime-filtered hourly pullbacks have positive costed OOS expectancy.
hypotheses.verdict: OOS mean -19.94 bps with direction, regime, drawdown and root collapses.

hypotheses.claim: OHLCV compression transitions have positive costed OOS expectancy.
hypotheses.verdict: OOS mean -9.81 bps and LCB -26.37 bps with direction and root collapses.

hypotheses.claim: Recent Bitget funding carry exceeds the executable cost floor.
hypotheses.verdict: No signal passed: maximum projected carry 7.35 bps versus 16 bps cost floor; historical split coverage is unavailable.

hypotheses.claim: Cross-sectional 4h trend survives costs and uncertainty.
hypotheses.verdict: Development means were positive, but LCB, directions, drawdown and baseline comparison failed.

hypotheses.claim: One long/short relative-momentum pair has positive costed edge.
hypotheses.verdict: 96 closed pairs, 13.04 bps mean but -74.06 bps LCB and excessive drawdown.

hypotheses.claim: Weekly top-two/bottom-two 4h momentum diversifies pair risk.
hypotheses.verdict: 96 portfolios, 50.83 bps mean but -22.99 bps LCB; drawdown and baseline gates failed.

hypotheses.claim: Walk-forward cointegration spreads retain edge after costs.
hypotheses.verdict: 94 trades, 2.57 bps mean, -27.62 bps LCB and -3.43 bps stress mean.

hypotheses.claim: At least one of nine simple strategy families survives one shared simulator and cost model.
hypotheses.verdict: Zero of ten preregistered strategies passed; all non-flat OOS means and LCBs were negative.

hypotheses.claim: Three compact microstructure sessions can calibrate spread, depth and execution assumptions.
hypotheses.verdict: Useful for execution calibration and parity checks; approximately 48 hours cannot establish alpha.

hypotheses.claim: The isolated Bitget Freqtrade dry-run can start deterministically without granting live authority.
hypotheses.verdict: NoTrade and deterministic pulse reached RUNNING; dry_run=false pulse startup is rejected.

rules_for_new_work: Create a new registry version before opening a new holdout.
Do not retune a terminal-rejected hypothesis on its revealed OOS.
Use one shared next-bar simulator and one shared fee/slippage contract.
A positive mean without positive LCB is not a candidate.
No research report or dry-run harness grants paper or live authority.
